credentials.help: Elysium tries active credentials in priority order, lowest number first. Tokens are encrypted and never shown again after saving. A signed-in Claude account is kept signed in by Elysium, which also shows its usage.

agentConfiguration.title: Agent configuration
agentConfiguration.help: Workers and Project Managers run Claude Code only with the configuration in this repository: its CLAUDE.md, docs, skills, and settings. Elysium fetches it when it starts, whenever this changes, and in every worker before its first turn, and leaves out what only another machine can run. Coding sessions and Elysia use the last fetch.
agentConfiguration.repositoryHint: An https git URL without credentials.
agentConfiguration.tokenHint: Reads a private github.com repository. A fine-grained token with read-only Contents on just this repository is enough.
agentConfiguration.loadError: The agent configuration could not be loaded.
agentConfiguration.adminOnly: Only admins change the agent configuration.
agentConfiguration.fetchNeedsSave: Save to fetch with these changes

hold.unset: No configuration repository is set, so workers and Project Managers wait.
hold.fetching: Fetching the configuration repository. Workers and Project Managers start once it is fetched.
hold.failed: The configuration repository could not be fetched, so workers and Project Managers wait.

skipReasons.missingCommand: Its command is not installed here.
skipReasons.missingPath: A path it names does not exist here.
skipReasons.loopback: It reaches a server on its owner's own machine.
skipReasons.notInstalled: Plugins install from a marketplace, which the repository does not carry.
skipReasons.reserved: Elysium sets this itself for every turn.

chatgpt-oauth.login: Sign in with your ChatGPT account. A browser window opens.
chatgpt-oauth.open: Open the credentials file Codex wrote. On Windows it is in your user folder under .codex.
chatgpt-oauth.copy: Copy the whole file into Secret token.

claude-code-oauth.signIn: Sign in with your Claude subscription in the browser window that opens.
claude-code-oauth.copy: Copy the token the terminal prints. It starts with sk-ant-oat01-.
claude-code-oauth.expiry: The token lasts one year. Use One year from now to set the expiry.

claude-api-token.open: Open API keys in the Anthropic Console.
claude-api-token.create: Choose Create key and give it a name.
claude-api-token.copy: Copy the key. It starts with sk-ant-api03- and is shown only once.

chatgpt-api-token.open: Open API keys on the OpenAI platform.
chatgpt-api-token.create: Choose Create new secret key and pick a project.
chatgpt-api-token.copy: Copy the key. It starts with sk- and is shown only once.
chatgpt-api-token.billing: Make sure the organization has billing set up, or requests fail.

claude-account.start: Choose Start sign-in. Elysium starts the Claude Code CLI in its workspace.
claude-account.open: Open Claude's sign-in page and sign in with your Claude subscription.
claude-account.code: Copy the code the page shows and paste it into Code.
claude-account.kept: Elysium refreshes the account from then on. Sign in again only if it shows Sign-in expired.

signIn.codeHint: Paste the code Claude's page shows after you sign in.
signIn.codeNeeded: Paste the code from Claude's page first
signIn.help: Elysium signs in with the official Claude Code CLI and keeps the account signed in, refreshing it before it lapses. Start the sign-in, sign in on Claude's page, and paste the code it shows.
